item.title: Christine Lagarde to step down as ECB president early, effective 7 February 2027
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) announced on Thursday that Christine Lagarde will leave her post as president on 7 February 2027, almost nine months before her term ends in October. According to European Council President Antonio Costa, the successor search has begun. (Sources: Europeiska centralbanken, The Japan Times, France 24, The Guardian, MercoPress)

item.title: Brazil's electoral authority: rules were followed in presidential election
item.description: Brazil's electoral authority says, according to DR, that all rules were followed in the presidential election. Dagens Nyheter reports that the authority rejects election fraud accusations made by Bolsonaro. (Sources: Agência Brasil, Dagens Nyheter)

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for US after election defeat
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro has left Brazil for the US after losing the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, according to several sources. He says he is Brazil's rightful leader, and his family is reported to have travelled with him. (Sources: Deutsche Welle, Washington Examiner, Hindustan Times, DR Nyheder, Al Jazeera)
